Definition: Whether the instant payment system supports direct person-to-person transfer of funds between individuals for informal transactions, remittances, and interpersonal value transfers.
Comments: P2P digital transfers exist via mobile money (e.g., MTN MoMo tariff table includes P2P on-net/off-net transfer fees), and eKash enables interoperable transfers across banks and mobile money platforms.

Definition: Whether and how the central bank participates in payment system governance beyond its regulatory oversight role, including board representation, operational management, technical standard-setting, or direct system operation.
Comments: National Bank of Rwanda (NBR) has direct operational role: it operates RIPPS (Rwanda Integrated Payments Processing System) and is regulator/overseer/catalyst in RNPS, and the payment-system law assigns NBR responsibility to regulate/oversee/supervise payment systems and to “operate a clearing and settlement system.”

Definition: Whether legal or regulatory requirements obligate payment service providers to notify users, regulators, and/or data protection authorities about payment data breaches, cybersecurity incidents, or unauthorized access within specified timeframes.
Comments: Rwanda’s Data Protection and Privacy Law provides mandatory breach notification (DPO/NCSA provides a ‘Report a Data Breach’ service; secondary summaries describe 48-hour notification obligations under the law).

Definition: Whether payment system operators or regulators regularly publish performance metrics and statistics on system usage, transaction volumes/values, participant numbers, uptime, and other operational indicators.
Comments: NBR provides public payment-system statistics (dedicated ‘Payment System Statistics’ page) and the payment-system law assigns NBR responsibility to “collect, compile and disseminate” payment-system statistics, but this step did not confirm quarterly/monthly publication cadence.

Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: Rwanda has a nationwide interoperable real-time payment system branded eKash (RNDPS 2.0), launched on 27 Feb 2025 at Inclusive Fintech Forum as the “National Digital Payment System,” enabling users to send/receive money across banks and mobile money platforms and supporting multi-channel payments.
